missing_jar.title: A Jar Gone Astray
missing_jar.summary: Miriam's water jar rolled away while the children were playing by the well.

objectives.text: Find Miriam's water jar. It rolled toward the olive grove.
Bring the jar back to Miriam.

word_jordan.title: Word from the Jordan
word_jordan.summary: A strange report has reached the village. What is really happening out in the wilderness?

objectives.text: Hear what is being said about a preacher at the Jordan.
Ask Elder Ezra what he makes of it.
Find someone who has seen the preacher with their own eyes.
